package probe

import (
	"os/exec"
	"reflect"
)

// Reflection reaches a command's fields by name, out of the check's sight: a
// nil-Env command built with reflect.New, or the Env reset here, is no shape
// the four accepted gaps cover, and the reflection is what makes it possible.
// In a file that imports os/exec, an import of reflect is a finding at the
// import line, a sibling of the generic-function rule (P6). No test/e2e file
// imports reflect today.

func reflectEnv(cmd *exec.Cmd) {
	cmd.Env = []string{}
	reflect.ValueOf(cmd).Elem().FieldByName("Env").Set(reflect.ValueOf([]string{"PATH=/usr/bin"}))
}
